requirement: Writing is idempotent: repeated delivery of an event (retry, update duplication, double invocation) does not create a duplicate.
note: P2 only. §2.5 idempotency covers schema migrations, not runtime writes (different axis) — P6 excluded by literal text.

requirement: Deduplication direction is correct: the current record is preserved, the old duplicate is suppressed (not the reverse).
Deduplication is by semantic/content key, not by source. Source diversity is preserved as provenance, not as duplicated memory.
note: P2 gives source-as-provenance, P8 gives duplicate_rate metric (§3.2); only their intersection is the content key.

requirement: Writing to multiple stores (message + vector + index) is transactional or compensable: partial writes are excluded.
note: P6 covers contracts/versioning of format, not atomicity/compensation. Adjacent, not covering — honest note kept from the gap era.
anchor: SPEC §2.5 Resilience (B4 write atomicity), canonized v0.3 (owner signature 2026-10-27)

requirement: Write failures are not silent: logged, metricked, retried with backoff; silent return without observability is unacceptable.
note: LOG-3.4 primary (Art12 mandatory logging + OTel §3.4); P8 secondary (measurability spirit + J3 regression guard §3.5). P8 literal text is eval-harness only, so LOG carries the claim.

requirement: Compressed representation (summary) and original are written consistently; an empty/failed compression does not replace the original.
note: P1 confidence_after <= confidence_before + F8 ceiling (§2.4); P2 append-only transformation_history.
